title: EXT_materials_bump glTF Material Extension
description: glTF extension that defines a bump which perturbs the surface normal.

bumpFactor.description: The bump height in metres per unit of the sampled red channel.
bumpFactor.gltf_detailedDescription: The bump height in metres per unit of the sampled red channel, measured in the space named by `heightSpace`. A negative value inverts the relief.

bumpTexture.description: A texture that defines the surface height in the red channel.
bumpTexture.gltf_detailedDescription: A texture that defines the surface height in the red channel. This will be multiplied by the bump factor.

heightSpace.description: The space in which the bump height is measured.
heightSpace.gltf_detailedDescription: The space in which the bump height is measured. `world` measures `bumpFactor` in world space. `object` measures it in the node's local space, so it scales with the node transform.
